schedule.epoch_range_note: prereg §1 sanctions 2-4; running the full sanctioned range with per-epoch checkpoints + evals — selection sees epochs 1..4
schedule.optimizer: AdamW, lr 1e-5 (conservative for full FT), weight_decay 0.01, cosine decay to 10% of peak, 20-step linear warmup, foreach=False (peak-RAM reduction)
schedule.determinism: training.distill.set_determinism(42); order_rng(42) pair shuffle per epoch
schedule.checkpointing: every epoch: model fp32 safetensors + tokenizer + optimizer.pt; ROLLING: optimizer.pt of epoch N deleted when epoch N+1 lands (keep-latest; r7 disk-reclaim precedent) — model weights of ALL epochs retained until selection

readouts: proxy by class (seed-dup/llm/real/twin): M_cal_median + S_cal_share_ge_085 at full 1024
mono_control_median (median best distractor cos) at full 1024
the SAME readouts truncated to first 384 dims + renormalised (predicts the stage-2 KD target space)
per_epoch_eval.note: BASE mono is NOT gate-bound (prereg §1) — trend recorded, no pass/fail line on stage-1 mono

selection_rule_FIXED_BEFORE_RUN.pool: epoch 0 (base, pre-FT) + FT epochs 1..4 — epoch 0 included BY DESIGN so a harmful FT degrades to the sweep-audited base instead of forcing a bad teacher
selection_rule_FIXED_BEFORE_RUN.candidates: pool members with mono_control_median >= base_mono - 0.010 (trend guard) AND cross_R@5 >= base_cross - 0.01 (geometry hold — the native cross-lingual geometry is the round's entire thesis, it must survive FT)
selection_rule_FIXED_BEFORE_RUN.rank: MAX (llm_median + seed_dup_median)/2 (the quality composite the round optimizes); tie: higher mono_control_median, then lower epoch
selection_rule_FIXED_BEFORE_RUN.guarantee: epoch 0 trivially passes candidate gates -> a selection ALWAYS exists; no route leads to an undefined teacher
selection_rule_FIXED_BEFORE_RUN.output: runs/embed-r8/ft_selection.json + runlog entry BEFORE stage-2 teacher precompute
